study type: Mixed-methods study combining observational analysis of human placental tissue and in vitro experimental cell culture.
cohort: Placentas collected from women who experienced spontaneous preterm birth (with or without labor) or full-term birth (with or without labor), alongside HTR8/SVneo cells.
finding: SNHG29 was overexpressed in placentas from women who delivered preterm with labor, and high levels of SNHG29 enhanced cellular senescence via p53/p21 signaling, increasing pro-inflammatory cytokine expression.
mod_finding: SNHG29 was overexpressed in placentas from women who delivered preterm with labor compared to those who underwent preterm birth without labor and full-term births.
cross-section timing: Placentas were collected at the time of birth.
